article.title: Pound discrimination
article.excerpt: A hotel in Germany has started charging its guests by the pound for an overnight stay, according to a Local 6 News report. The hotel owner in the town of Norden, Juergen Heckrodt, said he was continually getting overweight guests, so he decided to make them step on the scales to determine room costs.
